question: Compare B.Sc. academic progression and degree requirements with AICTE TFW eligibility, clearly separating the two documents.
answer:
Based on the provided documents, the requirements and criteria are as follows:

**B.Sc. Academic Progression and Degree Requirements ([B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15])**
- **Conditions for Pass and Progression:**
 - A student must have a CGPA of at least 4.5 to be declared promoted to the next class [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - The maximum duration permitted for completion of the program is 5 years for B.Sc. and 6 years for B.Sc. (Honours) / B.Sc. (Honours with Research) [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - No relaxation in credit limit beyond 28 credits will be allowed, and such cases are closely examined before approval by the VC taking into consideration past performance [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - A student having a CGPA of < 4.5 at the end of the second semester must repeat the first year; this facility is available only once (if CGPA at the end of the second semester is again less than 4.5, the student must discontinue studentship) [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].

- **Conditions for Award of a Degree:**
 - Secures a CGPA equal to 4.5 or more [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - Earns a minimum of 120 credits for B.Sc. or 160 credits for B.Sc. (Honours) / B.Sc. (Honours with Research) [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - Maximum duration of degree completion includes the period of rustication/expulsion but excludes semester withdrawal [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - Successfully completes the internship, if any [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].
 - No failure in the core courses [B_Sc_Acad_Sys_Aug23_ecddd80d28.pdf, p. 15].

- TFW is granted to 2% of the approved seats of the program, according to merit [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
- Students whose parents' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 8.00 lakhs per annum are eligible [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
- A valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only will be accepted [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
- Scholarships are awarded after the completion of the admission cycle [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
